title: Aureline M5 propagation-blocker gate
description: Canonical per-domain propagation-blocker gate minted by the retirement-closure-ledger and propagation-blocker-gate lane over the frozen M5 retired-state matrix. Blocks final retirement certification while a claimed deployment profile — a mirror, an offline bundle, a self-hosted registry / catalog, a policy bundle, or a managed new-tenant / new-workspace gate — has not yet converged on the same retired-state truth another profile already closed, so one profile can never keep advertising a retired line or capability after another has closed it. Records the propagation scope a blocker sits in — a profile whose retirement manifest, tombstone, or last-supported archive ref has not yet propagated (profile_propagation_lag), a profile whose retired-state truth disagrees with the closed profiles (profile_retired_state_mismatch), or a profile still offering a retired line or capability for new install / new tenant after another profile closed it (still_advertising_after_closure) — and binds the affected deployment-profile reference, the affected retirement-manifest reference, the diverging-versus-closed-profile reference, and the active block reason so mirror, offline, self-hosted, and managed surfaces read the propagation-convergence truth directly rather than re-deriving it by hand. The gate names the archival / successor path each profile still needs without leaking internal-only detail. Downstream surfaces point at this schema instead of restating a profile's propagation state by hand. Raw secret values and private endpoints never cross this boundary.
